title: Kagamine Rin — Mystery Path Discovered?!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI
Flower Field
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We're back again today♪
se_walk_men_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to check every single day. It's not like it's going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I can't help it. Especially since there might be flowers blooming today that weren't yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: True. This field's enormous, so what you're saying wouldn't be out of the ordinary.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But finding them sounds incredibly challenging...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You basically have to remember whether or not specific flowers were buds yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right. That's why I see it as a super duper hard spot-the-difference puzzle.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know! You guys should help me remember!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everything might be impossible, but we can split the work!

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The thing is, I want to be able to tell Minori and the others about any flowers that started blooming. Even if it's just one.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because that means they were able to spread hope to someone new.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And right now is a crucial time for the girls...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When they hear the good news, I'm sure it'll encourage and push them to reach even more people!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Seeing evidence of their success would give them a nice boost of confidence!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll help you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Covering this entire place is gonna be really hard, so we should probably narrow down our area.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, let's start with this part of the field in front of us!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm seeing nothing new in my section.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Same here. I don't think there are any new flowers blooming...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
My section too...
That's strange considering how many buds there are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We did narrow down our area a lot.
Some flowers might've bloomed in other places.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if we're going to try to cover this entire field...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It might be better to ask Minori and the others to take pictures of it for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right. They have their phones.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't think that far...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's okay, Rin.
We know that you meant well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. We probably wouldn't have arrived at that if you hadn't taken the initiative you did in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, Len...
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_men_003_2
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you three are here again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something the matter? You were all here yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want to tell them when even one new flower starts blooming? That's wonderful, Rin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to help you with that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. I'd rather not be left out.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
But my way of trying to remember everything probably isn't very good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it's great. It's fun coming every day to check whether the flowers we found are blooming.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: On our way here, I got excited thinking about whether or not the flowers we found by the pond have already started blooming.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, Rin, would you like for us to all help you with your giant spot-the-difference puzzle?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun♪
I'd like to play.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, me too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since there are six of us, we could split into teams of two and see who can spot the most differences!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Then, let's split into teams of two and start memorizing all of the flowers!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start by forming teams♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
